subregion_holes.blocking_note: Close these regions.json polygon gaps before compiling coordinate-box spawn files.

review_findings: Legs 1-8 are computed from terrain and are not fit to towns.json distances.
Victory Road is computed between measured Rift arm, fork, trunk and apex waypoints.
Every polyline point includes sampled elevation; route elevation records climb, grade and slope-limit exceedances.
Spawn rectangles exactly cover the 8-block corridor raster, keeping overspill below the 15% requirement.
Unassigned path intervals are explicit polygon holes and remain blockers for spawn compilation.

orchestration_changes: reject individual A* edges over 40 degrees
apply 25x traversal cost to authored sea/lake/river cells
force Victory Road through measured Rift axis waypoints
rasterize corridors at 8 blocks and merge exact row runs into boxes
derivation_record.limitation: The one-off orchestration script is not committed under the current write scope. Do not regenerate this artifact from a later tools/route_path.py without comparing the recorded hashes and algorithm notes.
